a: About 200 hours of mm-VLBI time on the four 21 m KVN telescopes, with simultaneous 22/43/86/129 GHz observing. No funding.
dt: Deadline 2 Nov 2026, 09:00 UT (18:00 KST); submission via the KVN website opened 1 Oct 2026. Observations 16 Jan to 15 Jun 2027 (can be spread to 15 Jan 2028 if requested).
e: KASI invites VLBI proposals for the Korean VLBI Network from astronomers around the world. (The separate KVN single-dish call is for the Korean community only.)
f: Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute (KASI)
n: Korean VLBI Network (KVN) VLBI Semester 2027A Call for Proposals
unv: Graduate-student PI eligibility is not stated.
